name: Stoddard Solvent
description: Stoddard Solvent (CAS 8052-41-3), also known as mineral spirits or white spirit, is a petroleum-derived hydrocarbon solvent mixture widely used in industrial cleaning and chemical processing. In the semiconductor industry, it serves as the active solvent in negative photoresist developer formulations, enabling the selective dissolution and removal of unexposed negative photoresist during photolithography. The solvent is valued for its controlled evaporation rate, excellent solvency for organic materials, and low residue characteristics. It is also used in degreasing, paint thinning, and precision cleaning applications across electronics manufacturing. High-purity electronic grades with controlled composition and low particulate content are available for semiconductor fabrication environments.
physicalProperties: Appearance: clear liquid; Boiling Range: 149-204 °C; Density: 0.78 g/cm³; Flash Point: 40-46 °C; Vapor Pressure: 4 mmHg at 20°C
